kicker: Liquid time constants, gated delta rules

scenes.headline: How a liquid time constant becomes a gated recurrence
scenes.sub: Liquid Time-constant Networks and Gated DeltaNet: two literatures, one update rule
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Gardenia! Liquid time-constant networks came from neuroscience, Gated DeltaNet from efficient Transformers. They're the same recurrence. Let's derive it.

scenes.text: Step LTC's ODE with its own fused solver, and it becomes a state that decays by an input-dependent factor each step: a gated linear recurrence.
scenes.say: Step the liquid network's equation with its own fused solver, and out comes a state that decays by an input-dependent factor: a gated linear recurrence.

scenes.title: LTC's fused solver, rearranged
scenes.text: x_t+1 = ᾱ x_t + ᾱ Δt g A
scenes.say: Rearrange one step of the solver, and the whole update reads like this.

parts.note: the old state, scaled by a factor between 0 and 1
parts.say: The old state is scaled by alpha bar, a number between zero and one.

parts.note: the write: the gate's output, pulling toward A
parts.say: Then a write: the gate's output, pulling the state toward a target.
And alpha bar depends on the input, through the gate: the same data-dependent alpha as Mamba2, Gated DeltaNet and KDA.

left.title: Gating alone
items: One number scales the whole state
Clears the table, can't pick up one plate
left.say: But gating alone multiplies the whole state by one number. It can clear the table, but not pick up a single plate.

right.title: The gated delta rule
items: Beta erases just the current key first
Clear the table, or lift one plate
right.say: The gated delta rule adds targeted erasure: alpha decays everything, beta wipes the current key before writing.

scenes.title: LTCAttention: a third place for it

steps.say: A new implementation, LTCAttention, puts the time constant on the attention score. The block's first token sets a bounded time constant per learned direction.
Along each direction, a key's weight decays with its age. Folded into queries and keys, standard attention stays the only quadratic step.

scenes.label: slower than the baseline, in a token-matched comparison
scenes.note: spent on baseline tokens, it may explain the whole gain
scenes.say: It wins per token, across three seeds, but runs twelve point four percent slower. Spent on baseline training, that could match the gain.

scenes.text: τ, α and a half-life are one number in three coordinate systems. The delta rule is what gating adds.
scenes.mark: one number in three coordinate systems
scenes.say: Tau, alpha and a half-life are one number in three coordinate systems. The delta rule is what gating adds.

recap: LTC's fused solver is a gated linear recurrence
The delta rule adds targeted erasure
LTCAttention: better per token, undetermined per second
scenes.say: To recap: one recurrence in two notations, a delta rule that erases one fact, and a hybrid awaiting a wall-clock test.
